name: Retail People Counting
description: Answers the three questions every store manager asks: how many customers came in, where do they linger, and who needs help right now? Automatic entry/exit counting plus browsing / engaged / assistance states put numbers behind staffing, displays and layout decisions.
description_zh: 回答门店经营最关心的三件事：今天来了多少客人？他们在哪儿停留？谁正需要帮助？自动统计进出客流、区分浏览/驻足/求助状态，让排班、陈列和动线调整有数可依。
author: Seeed Studio
